records.rationale: A semantic, layout-only root removes repeated full-height shell CSS without absorbing application behavior.

evidence.repeatedTemplateEvidence: The packed sidebar-header template and multiple approved sidebar recipes repeat a full-height flex shell root.
evidence.accessibility: The root preserves document landmarks and must reflow at 400% zoom.
evidence.state: Any responsive or persisted state remains controlled by the parent application.
evidence.ssr: The root has deterministic markup and no viewport-derived server default.
evidence.ownership: Layout only; routing, data loading, authentication, and application state are excluded.

records.rationale: A shell header slot is repeatedly composed around HeaderNav and benefits from a consistent grid-area boundary.

evidence.repeatedTemplateEvidence: Both packed application-header templates render a distinct top header region.
evidence.accessibility: The slot renders a header landmark while navigation semantics remain with HeaderNav.
evidence.state: The slot owns no open, navigation, or account state.
evidence.ssr: The header landmark and grid placement are identical across server and client.
evidence.ownership: Structural placement only; HeaderNav continues to own header interaction.

records.rationale: A shell sidebar slot standardizes responsive placement while reusing the existing Sidebar or NavigationMenu components.

evidence.repeatedTemplateEvidence: One packed template and three approved recipes repeat the same leading application-sidebar region.
evidence.accessibility: The slot renders an aside; consumers provide one labelled navigation landmark within it.
evidence.state: Visibility and persistence stay controlled by the application.
evidence.ssr: Desktop markup remains present and CSS controls layout without viewport reads.
evidence.ownership: Structural placement only; Sidebar and consumer navigation own interaction and route state.

records.rationale: A main slot centralizes the unique target ID, scroll containment, and shell grid placement repeated by application layouts.

evidence.repeatedTemplateEvidence: The packed shell and multiple recipes repeat a flexible, scrollable main content landmark.
evidence.accessibility: The slot provides the main landmark and a stable skip-link target.
evidence.state: The slot owns no route, loading, or view state.
evidence.ssr: Its landmark, ID, and content order are deterministic.
evidence.ownership: Content placement only; the application owns what route content renders.

records.rationale: The first template set does not establish a repeated secondary-panel width, priority, collapse, or landmark contract.

evidence.repeatedTemplateEvidence: Dashboard cards show secondary content, but no packed template repeats a shell-level secondary panel.
evidence.accessibility: Landmark naming and reading order need product evidence before standardization.
evidence.state: Open and collapse behavior is unresolved and must remain application-owned.
evidence.ssr: Responsive presence could alter the hydration tree without an approved CSS-only contract.
evidence.ownership: Deferred until repeated layouts prove a structural boundary.

records.rationale: Two packed header patterns and the sidebar recipes repeatedly require a distinct mobile navigation placement.

evidence.repeatedTemplateEvidence: HeaderNav.MobileTrigger and Drawer-based navigation recur across both packed application-header templates.
evidence.accessibility: The slot requires a labelled navigation region; Drawer/HeaderNav retain focus and escape behavior.
evidence.state: Open state is parent- or interaction-component-owned, never inferred by AppShell.
evidence.ssr: The slot is rendered deterministically and hidden or shown through responsive CSS.
evidence.ownership: Placement only; Drawer or HeaderNav owns modal interaction and the app owns routes.

records.rationale: A shell-level skip link is the missing accessibility counterpart to the repeatedly identified main region.

evidence.repeatedTemplateEvidence: Every repeated header/sidebar shell has navigation before main content, creating the same keyboard bypass need.
evidence.accessibility: The link becomes visible on focus and targets the AppShell main landmark.
evidence.ssr: The href and target ID are deterministic.
evidence.ownership: Keyboard bypass only; it does not coordinate application navigation.

records.rationale: No packed template supplies repeated pointer, keyboard, persistence, RTL, or minimum-size evidence for shell resizing.

evidence.repeatedTemplateEvidence: The recipes use fixed sidebar widths; none demonstrates an accessible resizable shell boundary.
evidence.accessibility: Keyboard resize semantics, announcements, zoom minimums, and touch targets remain unproven.
evidence.state: Width persistence and revision ownership require a separate controlled-state design.
evidence.ssr: Persisted sizes cannot safely affect initial layout until reconciliation is specified.
evidence.ownership: Deferred as an adapter rather than embedding unproven state in AppShell.
